verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.readme.com that tells agents to append .md to any page URL for Markdown. The evidence also shows per-section llms.txt indexes (workflows, ai, customizing-docs, the API reference). Beyond that, ReadMe documents agent-oriented features for hosted projects: AI discoverability scoring against the Agent-Friendly Docs spec, and a project MCP server that gives coding assistants a live connection to the docs. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents using these files in practice, and explicit documentation that customer hubs get llms.txt/.md output automatically.
